brief:
Settlers launched an assault on residential homes in the town of Araba, located south of Jenin, on Saturday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The attackers opened fire during the incident, targeting multiple properties in the Palestinian community.

The attack marks the latest in a series of settler violence incidents in the northern West Bank region. No immediate reports provided details on casualties or the scale of property damage sustained during the assault. Local residents have faced repeated episodes of settler aggression in recent months as tensions escalate across occupied Palestinian territories.
